# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 71 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 71 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_071_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 8, Part 2 — What the Rods Mean

**71:1** "Those whose rods were found withered and eaten through — these are the apostates, the betrayers of the church. They blasphemed the Lord through their sins, and they were ashamed of the name of the Lord that had been called over them. These people are completely dead to God. And you can see that not one of them repented — even after hearing the words you proclaimed to them. Life has left these people entirely."

**71:2** "Those who turned in rods that were dry and cracked — these are close to the apostates. They didn't fully apostatize, but they never produced any fruit either. Just as a dry rod bears no fruit, these people are alive in name but bear no fruit of any good work. Repentance is still available to them, but only if they act quickly. If they keep putting it off, they'll end up sharing the same death as the first group."

**71:3** "Lord," I said, "why can these people still repent, but not the first ones? Their rods looked just as bad." "Here's why repentance is still open for them," he said: "they didn't blaspheme the Lord, and they didn't betray the church. What they did was deceive through greed — each one lived for his own desires. So they can repent."

**71:4** "Now — those who turned in rods that were half-dry and cracked. Let me tell you about them. These are the people who are always wavering, always doubting, always speaking badly of each other. Many of them repented when they heard my commandments, and those who did repent were given a place in the first tower. The slower ones to repent were placed in the second tower."

**71:5** "Those who turned in rods that were green but dried at the tips — these were faithful people who were also wealthy, deeply caught up in worldly business. They're ashamed of the truth. Some of them heard my commandments and repented — they turned out fine. But the rest stayed in their affairs and cut themselves off from the holy ones. For them, getting into the third tower is going to be hard."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, making the systematic rod-typology of Similitude 8 clear and direct.*
